mandatoryNorms: Family gross annual income from all sources across preceding 3 financial years must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000/-.
Caste must be listed in Central/State OBC/VJNT/SBC schedule.
Must have verified Tahsildar / Executive Magistrate signature & municipal seal.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Annual income satisfies the Rs. 8,00,000/- ceiling under Gazette 2026/FST-12 Section 4.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Declared annual income exceeds the statutory Rs. 8,00,000/- ceiling.

mandatoryNorms: Documentary proof establishing ancestor residence in Maharashtra prior to 1950 (SC) or 1967 (OBC).
Duly executed Affidavit on Form 3 with genealogical family tree (Vanshavali).
Verification of Divisional Caste Scrutiny Committee stamp and Vigilance Cell report.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Primary ancestral records pre-date statutory cutoff year with verified genealogical tree.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Missing ancestral proof pre-dating the statutory cutoff year (1950/1967).

mandatoryNorms: Cross-verification of 3-year ITR or employer Form 16.
Talathi (Village Officer) local enquiry verification report.
Agricultural yield income assessment against 7/12 land crop patterns.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Income disclosures match Talathi ground report and tax records.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Discrepancy between declared income and verified land crop / tax disclosures.

mandatoryNorms: Potkharaba (uncultivable) land deduction calculation.
Verification of e-Mahabhumi digital watermark and sub-registrar hash.
Zero active judicial stay orders or pending bank attachment encumbrances in Ferfar register.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Land title is unencumbered with authenticated e-Mahabhumi digital seal.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Active dispute, pending mutation litigation, or encumbrance detected.

mandatoryNorms: Minimum 40% certified disability percentage evaluated by District Medical Board.
Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration verification.
Authorized Civil Surgeon signature and District Hospital seal.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Certified disability >= 40% with verified UDID registry and Civil Surgeon signature.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Certified disability percentage is below 40% statutory welfare threshold.

statutoryRules.gazetteNotification: 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act & State Gazette EWS-2024

mandatoryNorms: Family gross annual income below Rs. 8,00,000/- for the fiscal year prior to application.
Family does not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land.
Residential flat area does not exceed 1000 sq. ft.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Meets all income and property criteria prescribed under 103rd Constitutional Amendment.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Exceeds income ceiling or asset ownership limits specified under EWS norms.

mandatoryNorms: Continuous residence in the State for minimum 15 years supported by ration card/school leaving certificates.
Birth certificate or parent domicile attestation.
Police verification clearance for adult applicants.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: 15-year continuous residence proof verified with authenticated municipal birth records.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Continuous residence falls short of statutory 15-year requirement.

mandatoryNorms: Applicant name recorded as primary landholder on verified 7/12 extract.
Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS) no-dues clearance.
Crop inspection survey entry (Pik Pahani) in current Kharif/Rabi season.

outcomes.PASS: ELIGIBLE: Verified farmer status with unencumbered agricultural title and PACS solvency clearance.
outcomes.REJECT: INELIGIBLE: Outstanding loan default or absence of current crop cultivation entry.
